parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Default value: **1**
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为**1**，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned per page during paging.
> Set PageSize to a non-empty value
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
> 建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The type of the defense switch. Valid values:
- **image_repo**: image repository defense
parameters.help_zh:
防御开关类型。取值：
- **image_repo**：镜像仓防御
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The dimension of the defense switch configuration. Valid values:
- **image_repo**: image repository ID
parameters.help_zh:
防御开关的配置的操作维度。取值：
- **image_repo**：镜像仓ID
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the image repository
parameters.name: repo_name

parameters.help_en: The namespace of the container image repository
parameters.help_zh: 容器镜像仓库的命名空间
parameters.name: repo_namespace

parameters.help_en:
The operation type. Valid values:

- **count**: statistics
- **other**: other
parameters.help_zh:
操作类型。取值：

- **count**：统计
- **other**：其他
parameters.name: operate_type

parameters.help_en:
The search field. Valid values:

- **repoName**: image repository name
- **repoNamespace**: image repository namespace

> This parameter takes effect only when **OperateType** is set to **other**
parameters.help_zh:
检索字段。取值：

- **repoName**：镜像仓名称
- **repoNamespace**：镜像仓命名空间

> **OperateType**为**other**时该参数有效
parameters.name: field_name

parameters.help_en:
The value of the search field.
> This parameter takes effect only when **OperateType** is set to **other**
parameters.help_zh:
检索字段对应值。
> **OperateType**为**other**时该参数有效
parameters.name: field_value

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the item is selected. Valid values:
- **0**: No.
- **1**: Yes
parameters.name: selected
